cards.title: Short title, commencement and application
cards.easy: Section 1 gives the short title of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023 and specifies its commencement and application.
cards.takeaway: Introduces the Sanhita and explains where and when it applies.

cards.title: Definitions
cards.easy: Section 2 contains important definitions used in the Sanhita. These meanings help readers understand how specific terms are used throughout the law.
cards.takeaway: Defines important terms used throughout the Sanhita.

cards.title: General explanations
cards.easy: Section 3 provides general explanations that help interpret and apply provisions of the Sanhita correctly.
cards.takeaway: Helps in understanding how provisions of the Sanhita are interpreted.
